items.title: Adobe names longtime exec Anil Chakravarthy CEO, Narayen shifts to executive chair
items.summary: Investing.com -- Adobe said on Thursday that Anil Chakravarthy will become its next president and chief executive officer, succeeding longtime CEO Shantanu Narayen as the software maker looks to accelerate its growth in artificial intelligence. Chakravarthy, currently president of Adobe’s Customer Experience Orchestration business and worldwide field operations, will take over as CEO and join Adobe’s board on Dec. 1.
